metas.name: Unmadham
metas.description: Haunted by his past, a police constable reopens an unsolved cold case. As hidden secrets surface, he must confront truths that challenge his beliefs forever.

metas.name: Manichitrathazhu
metas.description: A young couple, Ganga and Nakulan, arrives at the ancestral home called Madampalli of the latter. Hailing from a family that follows tradition and superstitions, Nakulan's uncle Thampi objects to the couple's idea of moving into the allegedly haunted mansion, which Nakulan ignores. The couple moves in anyway following which seemingly supernatural events begin to happen.

metas.name: Ima Chimmathe
metas.description: Dreams Dreams Dreams...  Are they real?

metas.name: Faces
metas.description: Nitya grapples with post-traumatic stress disorder after her partner, Michael, vanishes. Consequently, she identifies his features in strangers while investigating the mystery of his disappearance.

metas.name: The Cycle
metas.description: After a collision with a cyclist, a reckless driver finds himself caught in something strange. His search for answers pulls him deeper into the unknown.

metas.name: Kishkindha Kaandam
metas.description: Strange events unfold in a monkey-inhabited village, driving a newlywed couple and forest officials to embark on a mission to uncover the root of the unusual disturbances.

metas.name: Sookshmadarshini
metas.description: Manuel returns with his mother to their former home in a middle-class neighbourhood. Suspicious of his intentions, Priyadarshini and her friends begin gathering clues, convinced he may be hiding something sinister.

metas.name: Rorschach
metas.description: When Luke Antony's wife goes missing, he sets off to search for her and stumbles upon the Balan family. However, terrorising events start occurring as Luke grows closer to them.

metas.name: Dheeram
metas.description: A police officer investigates pattern killings in Calicut, discovering a vengeful killer's scheme. As he unravels the truth, he faces a moral dilemma between law and justice for a bereaved parent.

metas.name: Heaven
metas.description: Circle Inspector of Police, Peter Kurishinkal is a stoic and taciturn officer, who prefers brain over brawn to solve his cases. His world is brought upside down when he is assigned a sensational case of a homicide.

metas.name: Rekhachithram
metas.description: Having recently served a suspension for gambling online while on duty, Circle Inspector Vivek Gopinath rejoins the police force and is looking to reclaim his lost honour. Awaiting him is a 40-year-old, unresolved murder mystery with a faceless victim.

metas.name: Ozhivudivasathe Kali
metas.description: On an election holiday, five friends get together for a booze party. Their only intention is fun and refreshment. As the time passes they start to open up the hidden wildness of their real nature. Tired and bored in arguments they plan to play a game. A game they used to play in their childhood.

metas.name: Dominic and the Ladies' Purse
metas.description: Dominic, a disgraced ex-cop turned detective, takes on a seemingly simple case to locate a purse's owner, which unveils a dark web of missing persons, murder, a stalker and the mysterious dancer Nandhita.

metas.name: Mr. Fraud
metas.description: Bhai Ji is a high-tech robber who changes his looks frequently. Disguised as jewelry experts, he and his team members hatch a plan to steal precious jewelry from a palace in Kerala.

metas.name: Identity
metas.description: A sketch artist and a cop work together to unravel the identity of an elusive killer using the descriptions of his face, etched into the memory of an eye-witness to the brutal crime

metas.name: The Tetrahedron
metas.description: Maya the protagonist, on her way to the college, hears a radio news of a strange geometrical figure with the shape of a ‘tetrahedron’ that appears from nowhere besides the Nazca lines in Peru. In the mean time, Maya’s friend Divya’s father, Neelan, goes missing. Few days later he is found from a distant land with signatures of pre-historic habitats around the place. Maya meets a few people from distant lands, of different races, roaming around a desolated architecture. Are they humanoid creatures? By the end of the film, through a dream passage that connects both Maya and Divya, we get to know about the disappearance of Maya.

metas.name: Careful
metas.description: A journalist, investigating traffic violations in a city, comes across mysterious happenings and lands herself in a dangerous situation.

metas.name: Dose
metas.description: Bodies begin to pile up in a hospital meant to save lives, forcing a doctor with a troubled past to confront buried secrets when a woman from his past returns. As the investigation deepens, each revelation becomes more dangerous than the last.

metas.name: Innale
metas.description: After a serious accident a girl who was hospitalized forgets her past. She stops worrying about her past when she fall in love with a man and finds herself secure with him.

metas.name: Eko
metas.description: In the misty hills of Kaattukunnu, an aging woman and her servant boy struggle to survive the ghosts of the past, as the hunt for Kuriachan — a legendary dog breeder and outlaw — blurs the line between myth, memory, and vengeance, revealing that even in absence, he still rules the hills.

metas.name: Bhoothakaalam
metas.description: Following the death of a family member, a mother and son experience mysterious events which distort their sense of reality and make them question their sanity.

metas.name: Classmates
metas.description: Years after graduating from college, a few friends from across the world decide to get together for a reunion. But on the night of the reunion, one of them attempts suicide and goes into a coma.

metas.name: Nidhiyum Bhoothavum
metas.description: Three young mechanics move their bike repair workshop to an isolated homestay rumoured to be haunted - only to encounter chilling, unexplained events that soon come to life and cannot be ignored.

metas.name: The Protector
metas.description: A detective investigates mysterious deaths at Manakkal Tharavadu manor in Airavathakkuzhi village, where locals fear evil haunts. His probe into family secrets unleashes dangerous events affecting the community.

metas.name: Mirage
metas.description: A woman joins forces with a journalist to investigate secrets her fiancé was keeping from her after she is informed he has died in a tragic train accident.

metas.name: Mutta Kallan
metas.description: Britto, a skinny young man striving to get fit, relies on eggs for his protein boost. But when his eggs mysteriously start disappearing, suspicions rise among his four housemates. As frustration builds, Britto is determined to catch the culprit behind the missing eggs.

metas.name: Ela Veezha Poonchira
metas.description: Sudhi and Madhu are police officers at a small wireless police station on the hilltop. Amidst the heavy monsoon, they receive word that a woman`s body parts have been scattered all over Elaveezhapoonchira. Will they solve the mystery?

metas.name: Mumbai Police
metas.description: ACP Antony Moses is on the verge of uncovering his friend’s murderer when an accident leaves him with partial memory loss. Reassigned to the same case, he must retrace his own forgotten steps to uncover a truth more shocking than he imagined.

metas.name: Harikrishnans
metas.description: When Guptan, a college lecturer, gets killed, the police suspect Gabriel to be the murderer. A girl takes help from her brothers, who are famous lawyers, in proving his innocence.

metas.name: Bougainvillea
metas.description: A family entangled in a police investigation surrounding the mysterious disappearance of tourists in Kerala.

metas.name: Aagathan
metas.description: Aagathan is the love story of Gautham and Shreya that turns sour because of Shreya's father, Major General Hareendra Natha Varma's one deed that comes back to haunt his family.

metas.name: Vismayathumbathu
metas.description: Sreekumar comes across a girl while visiting his childhood friend, Govindan Kutty. However, he later realises that she is the spirit of a student who disappeared a while ago.

metas.name: John Luther
metas.description: Devikulam Police Station SI John Luther is a committed police officer, who even risks his life for policing. During an interrogation, he suffers ruptured eardrums and hearing loss. Will he be able to complete an investigation which he had to leave halfway?
